author: Good Enough
description:
These Japanese soldiers never learned World War 2 had ended. After Japan surrendered in 1945, soldiers like Hiroo Onoda, Shoichi Yokoi, and Teruo Nakamura continued hiding in jungles for years, and in some cases decades, believing the war was still ongoing.

This video explores the true stories of the Japanese holdouts who refused to surrender after World War 2, surviving alone in remote jungles while the rest of the world moved on. From hidden shelters deep in the wilderness to guerrilla warfare and decades of isolation, these men continued carrying out orders long after the war had officially ended.

Some returned home as heroes, while others faced criticism for the actions they took while hiding. Their stories reveal the psychological toll of war, survival, loyalty, and what happens when soldiers are left behind for decades without knowing the truth.

title: The War Ended... But They Never Got the Message

description:
If an eagle attacks you, knowing how to react could save you from serious injury.

Eagles are powerful birds of prey with sharp talons capable of causing major damage if they feel threatened or become aggressive. This video explains what to do during an eagle attack, the mistakes that make the situation worse, and how to protect yourself while escaping safely.

This Short breaks down survival tips for one of the most dangerous bird encounters in the wild.
